description: This file defines the Event class in the Goteo project, representing event entities with methods for retrieval, validation, saving, and executing callbacks, including handling of duplicates and exceptions.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Model class representing an event with properties, retrieval, validation, persistence, and callback execution functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an Event object with specified action and type.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an event instance by action.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an event instance by ID.

methods.name: getByHash
methods.description: Retrieves an event instance by hash.

methods.name: getFrom
methods.description: Retrieves an event instance by a specified field.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if an event with a given hash exists, optionally only succeeded events.

methods.name: encodeAction
methods.description: Encodes an action array into a string or returns the string if already a string.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action and hash for the event, throws exception if duplicate.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the event to the database, handling errors.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the event, checking for duplicates.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets a PHP callback to be associated with the event.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Executes the callback, saves results, and handles exceptions.
